raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  # keep this without major version to let the bot pick it up
  # protobuf doesn't add the major version in the tag, it's defined per language in
  # https://github.com/protocolbuffers/protobuf/blob/main/version.json
  # libprotobuf can have a different major version than protobuf
  version: "35.1"
  major: 7
  lib_major: 7
  bz_url: https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/releases/download
  bz_ver: 8.7.0
  bz_artefact: ${{ "bazel_nojdk" if unix else "bazel" }}
  bz_fn: ${{ "bazel-standalone-" ~ bz_ver  if unix else "bazel.exe" }}
  # Windows ARM64 runs the x86-64 Bazel binary under emulation.
  bz_arch: ${{ "linux-x86_64" if build_platform == "linux-64" else
               "linux-arm64" if build_platform == "linux-aarch64" else
               "darwin-x86_64" if build_platform == "osx-64" else
               "darwin-arm64" if build_platform == "osx-arm64" else
               "windows-x86_64.exe" }}
  bz_hash: ${{ "83a0ec39f7ef3938b651c82d77ababfe96a9e4b9b566d7633f1c5f2ee9d2c8ed" if build_platform == "linux-64" else
               "15f5a93b8d2179b1dbb53fd54ba3720ea7f3261d482641d61547acbd08733817" if build_platform == "linux-aarch64" else
               "ac6175783fc463cc8f764353a52d4136550834d8855808086e7e21514f3c6ccd" if build_platform == "osx-64" else
               "fb49e0b21742c29ae1b413396af49d5a9cc1d0d7b6b958df4335225ad5f8d4ad" if build_platform == "osx-arm64" else
               "29f1796f57379933340afa135f02703ffa21dd30135754bea695f8fd15103420" }}

package:
  name: protobuf
  version: ${{ major ~ "." ~ version }}

source:
  - url: https://github.com/protocolbuffers/protobuf/archive/refs/tags/v${{ version }}.tar.gz
    sha256: 22775f9376938295efa2d59a59bde4cd075a42df5a9b4d27aa9b99fa6a413bd2
    patches:
      # backport https://github.com/protocolbuffers/protobuf/pull/17207 to avoid upb leakage
      - patches/0001-Make-our-Python-source-wheel-use-the-version-script-.patch
      - patches/0002-don-t-link-statically-on-windows.patch
      - patches/0003-enable-windows-as-a-target-for-python-bindings.patch
      - patches/0004-Support-more-architectures-for-Python-bindings.patch
      - patches/0005-Compatible-windows-changes.patch
      - patches/0006-Add-osx-64-and-linux-ppc64le-as-supported-wheel-tags.patch
      - patches/0007-Workaround-nvcc-bug-in-message_lite.h.patch
      - patches/0008-Add-ppc64le-to-python-dist-ABI-suffix-map.patch
      - if: win
        then:
          - patches/0009-Hacky-windows-workarounds.patch
        else:
          # TF_SYSTEM_LIBS (or rather: abseil_dll setup) not compatible with windows
          - patches/0010-unvendor-abseil-zlib.patch
      - if: win and arm64
        then:
          # Upstream v35.1 defines Windows wheel platforms only for x86 and x86-64.
          - patches/0011-Add-Windows-ARM64-Bazel-platform-and-wheel-tag.patch
          # Clang's MSVC ARM64 target does not define __SEH__, so the upstream
          # alignment guard does not prevent an SEH unwind-info compiler crash.
          - patches/0012-Avoid-p2align-on-Windows-ARM64.patch

  - url: ${{ bz_url }}/${{ bz_ver }}/${{ bz_artefact }}-${{ bz_ver }}-${{ bz_arch }}
    sha256: ${{ bz_hash }}
    file_name: ${{ bz_fn }}

build:
  number: 5

requirements:
  build:
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - python
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
        - libabseil
        - zlib
        # - libprotobuf ${{ lib_major ~ "." ~ version }}.*
    - if: unix
      then:
        - bazel-toolchain >=0.3.1
        - openjdk 21.*
        - sed
      else:
        - python
        - m2-sed
    - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
    - ${{ compiler('c') }}
    - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
  host:
    - python
    - pip
    - setuptools
    - if: unix
      then:
        - libabseil
        - zlib
    # - libprotobuf ${{ lib_major ~ "." ~ version }}.*
  run:
    - python
  run_constraints:
    - libprotobuf ${{ lib_major ~ "." ~ version }}.*

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - google
        - google.protobuf
        - google.protobuf.descriptor
        - google.protobuf.internal
        - google.protobuf.pyext
        - google.protobuf.util
        - google.protobuf.compiler
        - google._upb._message
      pip_check: true
  - script:
      - python -c "from google.protobuf.internal import api_implementation; print(api_implementation.Type())"
      - python -c "from google.protobuf.internal import api_implementation; assert api_implementation.Type() == 'upb'"

about:
  license: BSD-3-Clause
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: Protocol Buffers - Google's data interchange format.
  description: |
    Protocol buffers are Google's language-neutral, platform-neutral, extensible
    mechanism for serializing structured data,think XML, but smaller, faster, and simpler.
  homepage: https://developers.google.com/protocol-buffers/
  repository: https://github.com/protocolbuffers/protobuf
  documentation: https://developers.google.com/protocol-buffers/docs/tutorials

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - jjerphan
    - JohanMabille
    - dopplershift
    - jakirkham
    - ocefpaf
    - hajapy
    - xhochy
    - conda-forge/libprotobuf
